# Nikolai Zhukov

> Mathematician and ML engineer (Diplom in Mathematics and Computer Science, with distinction).
> Current Research focus: mechanistic interpretability of transformers — the geometric
> structure of temporal representations and how it deforms under context,
> studied in Gemma 2 2B with GemmaScope SAEs. Advanced through MATS
> Autumn 2026 selection assessments. 8+ years production ML (Python, Rust).
> Based in German since 2011. German citizen.

## Key work

- [Dilusion of time: how Gemma represents temporal concepts](https://nikozhuk.github.io/posts/time):
  five temporal categories (past/present/future/counterfactual/hypothetical)
  probed at layer 20; PCA geometry across layers 8 - 25 shows continuous
  structure that discrete SAE latents do not cleanly separate — one latent
  (1858) dominates all temporal categories. Also reproduces the circular
  days-of-week geometry (Engels et al., arXiv:2405.14860).
- [Finding joy in Gemma 2 2B](https://nikozhuk.github.io/posts/emotions):
  reproduction of Anthropic's emotion-concept methodology on open weights;
  SAE latent 1673 fires on 19/20 joy prompts vs 3/20 neutral
  (mean activation 21.2 vs 1.97).
- [About](https://nikozhuk.github.io/about.html): background - DFKI
  Saarbruecken (MeshGraphNet/GAT surrogate models for laser-cutting thermal
  simulation), plaicube.ai (LLM evaluation framework — cost/latency/quality
  benchmarking - with Whisper STT/TTS on a Rust core), Pragmatic Minds
  (CV + RL for industrial topology optimization), KPMG (production document
  AI at scale), Google Gemma hackathon (Gemma 4 on Raspberry Pi for
  ischemic stroke recovery).

## Current

- How temporal representation geometry deforms under context
  (stress vs. calm, cultural framing); SAE analysis beyond layer 20.
- Explaining transformer architecture as comics (in progress).
